full_page.content:
1928, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 43 Cont.
Mrs. Whalen - Wyandotte - Diphtheria Case - Transfusion To-day Alphonse Drene - Enemic 8 yrs.
Page 44 J. I. Sullivan - ?? .... 3 months vanished ! ! Mrs. Smith 68 - Very Sick - prayers Lump in breast forgotten ... Deo Br .!
4/11/'28 Mary Mc Farlane 21 of 1217 Duffern, Windsor - Enrolled this P.M. - not able to sit up after four years Consumption (T.B.) a per- petual member .... Nov. 7 reported as decidedly better - good appetite O.K. Deo Gr .!
Mrs. Baehr 57 Provid'ce Hosp'1
Coneff - Garland -
Mr. & Mrs. Mills ..... Beaconsfield Ave., Grosse Pt.
Poor little Helen Ramsey? - Restless - St. Vitas ..... Dear little child
Virginia Meldrone - cancer! O.K.
Two Sisters - Hohendorf 13 & 20 - hopeless with diphtheria prayed for last Wed. & enrolled - one had enough for 3 - They are now O.K. - Thanks. . Thanks
Francis Jacobi - 7 Ann Arbor Hosp'1. .
Page 45 Nov. 14 Non Cath. 4 yr. old girl - 2 yrs. paralyzed - parents
Ray Boligare 30 - drinking - terrible - breaking Mother's & Sisters' hearts - like possessed - Enrolled To-day perpetually.
Cavanagh - Family misunderst'g
Oneil 14 yrs old O.K. from T.B.
